# Mango's Photo Booth & Entertainment
> Luxury photo booth, keychain, and magnet-station rentals for weddings,
> corporate events, birthdays, and quinceañeras in Southwest Florida.

- Service area: Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Naples, Marco Island, Estero, Bonita Springs, and surrounding Southwest Florida (Lee & Collier counties). Service-area business — we travel to your venue.
- Phone: +1-239-888-7688
- Email: info@mangosphotobooth.com
- Booking: CheckCherry reservation flow at https://mangos-photo-booth-and-entertainment.checkcherry.com/reservation

## Packages (all include 3 hours of service + free SWFL travel)
- Mango's Luxury Experience — $550 (open-air booth, touchscreen kiosk, unlimited on-site prints, choice of 2×6 or 4×6 print size, 1 custom template, themed props, standard backdrop, attendant, private gallery)
- Mango's Platinum Experience — $650, most popular (everything in Luxury plus animated GIF creation, skin-perfecting beauty filter, upgraded deluxe backdrop, both print sizes, 2 custom templates)
- Mango's Big Kahuna Experience — $1,400 (all-inclusive: full Platinum Experience with animated GIF creation plus VIP red carpet with gold stanchions, premium custom backdrop, a live keychain or magnet station, a Mango Memory Frame loaded with all your photos, and a custom decor enhancement — balloons, arch, or florals)
- Add-on: Live Keychain or Magnet Memory Station can be added to the Luxury or Platinum experience for take-home favors.

## Details
- Photos shared instantly by text and email at the event; full private gallery delivered within 48 hours.
- Events served: weddings, corporate / brand activations, birthdays, quinceañeras, holiday parties.
